reserveReview.rationale: mHYPER is a certificate tracking a managed market-neutral reference portfolio. The September 14 dashboard discloses dated protocol exposures, including anonymously labelled Cex1, Cex2 and Cex3 positions. These protocol weights do not establish underlying asset composition or complete custody identity. The NAV envelope remains unresolved pending complete position and liability reconciliation.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Named protocol exposures provide partial evidence, but do not identify complete underlying asset weights; anonymous CEX exposures and unresolved liabilities prevent complete reviewed dependency links.

Assets are actively deployed across protocols and venues, so provider allocation, venue segregation, and reuse conditions remain strategy-dependent.
